articles.title: Robinhood Chain surges into top five by DEX volume: Bernstein
articles.snippet: Robinhood's new blockchain quickly became a top-five network by DEX volume, signaling strong early demand for its tokenized asset platform, the broker said.

articles.title: Paradigm shifts vs bubbles: AI chips and bitcoin show powerful trends can still produce severe corrections
articles.snippet: Structural change can create lasting opportunities, but explosive rallies in semiconductors, metals and bitcoin show how quickly strong narratives can become speculative excess.

articles.title: Signs of life?: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Several sources told CoinDesk that a new draft of the Clarity Act may drop this week, but challenges remain.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s BIP 110 fork deadline nears with miner support at zero
articles.snippet: The BIP 110 proposal would cap arbitrary data on Bitcoin for a year, but Michael Saylor, Adam Back and others say turning a spam dispute into a consensus fight could create a bigger risk than the spam itself.

articles.title: Bitcoin threatens $62K in risk-asset rout as Donald Trump says US will 'run' closed Hormuz Strait
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bulls faced an uphill struggle to preserve $62,000 as stocks opened down on Strait of Hormuz rhetoric between the US and Iran.
